patterns.name: SQL Statement Injection In Request Parameters
patterns.basis: Cl0p exploited the MOVEit Transfer SQL injection (CVE-2023-34362) and APT41 used SQL injection against public web applications (T1190).

patterns.name: Script Tag Injection In Request Parameters
patterns.basis: APT28 and Winter Vivern sent script injection payloads to Roundcube webmail (CVE-2020-35730, CVE-2023-5631) to run code in victim sessions (T1190).

patterns.name: Repeated Parent Directory Traversal Sequences
patterns.basis: APT41 exploited the Citrix ADC directory traversal (CVE-2019-19781) and UNC5221 the Ivanti Connect Secure path traversal (CVE-2023-46805) (T1190).

patterns.name: JNDI Lookup Injection (Log4Shell Style)
patterns.basis: C0018 and Magic Hound exploited Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) in VMware Horizon and Log4j; APT41 did so during C0017 (T1190).

patterns.name: OGNL / Expression Language Injection
patterns.basis: Rocke exploited Apache Struts, FIN13 exploited Primefaces EL injection (CVE-2017-1000486), and Ember Bear exploited Confluence OGNL (CVE-2021-26084) (T1190).

patterns.name: Unsafe Object Deserialization Payload
patterns.basis: APT41 exploited Zoho ManageEngine unsafe deserialization (CVE-2020-10189) and .NET deserialization; FIN13 abused WebSphere SOAP deserialization (CVE-2015-7450); Blue Mockingbird exploited Telerik (CVE-2019-18935) (T1190).

patterns.name: OS Command Injection In Request Parameters
patterns.basis: Cutting Edge threat actors used Ivanti Connect Secure command injection (CVE-2024-21887); Rocke and Quad7 achieved remote code execution via exposed services and SOHO routers (T1190).

patterns.name: Server-Side Request Forgery To Internal Resources
patterns.basis: Anthropic AI-orchestrated Campaign used a custom exploit for an SSRF vulnerability, and ProxyLogon (CVE-2021-26855) is an SSRF used by Threat Group-3390, HAFNIUM, ToddyCat and BlackByte (T1190).

patterns.name: Microsoft Exchange ProxyLogon / ProxyShell Request Paths
patterns.basis: APT28, Threat Group-3390, HAFNIUM, Magic Hound, Play and BlackByte exploited Exchange (CVE-2020-0688, ProxyLogon, ProxyShell, ProxyNotShell) (T1190).

patterns.name: Microsoft SharePoint Exploit Request Paths
patterns.basis: Threat Group-3390, VOID MANTICORE, HomeLand Justice and SharePoint ToolShell Exploitation exploited SharePoint (CVE-2019-0604, CVE-2025-49706, CVE-2025-49704) (T1190).

patterns.name: VPN / Edge Appliance Exploit Request Paths
patterns.basis: APT29, APT5, Volt Typhoon, Fox Kitten, UNC3886, Operation MidnightEclipse and Salt Typhoon exploited Citrix, Pulse/Ivanti, FortiOS, Palo Alto GlobalProtect and Cisco devices (T1190).

patterns.name: Authentication Bypass By Path Confusion
patterns.basis: Cutting Edge used Ivanti authentication bypass (CVE-2023-46805), SharePoint ToolShell used authentication bypass (CVE-2025-49706), and the Fortinet CVE-2022-40684 style bypass abuses path handling (T1190).

patterns.name: Web Shell Upload Or Execution Request
patterns.basis: Public-facing servers (JBoss, WebLogic, GlassFish, Exchange, Confluence) exploited by Operation Wocao, GOLD SOUTHFIELD, Earth Lusca and Cinnamon Tempest were followed by web shell deployment (T1190).

patterns.name: Probe Of Exposed Network Service Or Management Protocol
patterns.basis: T1190 covers databases, SMB, SSH, SNMP and Smart Install exposed to the Internet; Qilin was delivered via exposed Citrix and RDP (T1190).

patterns.name: Exposed Admin Interface Or Misconfiguration Probe
patterns.basis: ShadowRay exploited exposed Ray servers (CVE-2023-48022) and TeamPCP abused misconfigured GitHub Actions and cloud services (T1190).

patterns.name: Automated Exploitation Tool Signature
patterns.basis: sqlmap and Havij automate SQL injection, Volatile Cedar used automatic vulnerability discovery, and Anthropic AI-orchestrated Campaign automated exploitation with Claude Code (T1190).
